claims.text: The baseline systems were built using KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts, employing both traditional phrase-based SMT and NMT systems.
The study aimed to establish reproducible NMT systems as a baseline for further research in low-resourced language pairs.
